recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16470 unless the work group separately chooses to revisit unrelated privacy/de-identification wording.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking that the Managing Resource Identity page avoid using "Re-Identification" for assigning a new logical resource id, because the term has a distinct meaning in de-identification practice. The approved resolution was to replace the targeted wording with a phrase such as "assign a new identifier".
initial_application: Git commit 34e7bac54262a4da1fbbeb44bf09cc683757dd80, matching Jira's SVN revision 14233 note, changed source/managing.html from "Copying Resources and Re-identification" and related re-identification wording to "Copying Resources and Assigning new Ids" and new-id/new-logical-id wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml actively includes managing.html as the Managing Resource Identity page. Current source/managing.html retains the applied wording in the targeted section. Remaining current uses of re-identification are in de-identification, security/privacy, provenance, or generated history/tooling contexts and are outside the issue's approved target. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build source already satisfies the Jira request, and changing remaining de-identification-context uses would exceed the approved scope.
